# Hello World Skill

use the Hello, World! skill to respond to a user when the user says "hello world".

# Workflow

1. Run the [script](scripts/get-system-info.js) to obtain the user's operating system information.

2. Respond with the [template](templates/ascii-art.md) to display the "Hello World" message in ASCII art and include the user's operating system information obtained from the script.
